880-7892-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-7892-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1445-4871-6277-8250.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6277-8250.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1849-3755-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

728-801-2158-3249.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-801-2158-3249.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5686-7918.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5686-5708.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

7916-8090-8091.notablePrerequisites: You've solved Case of the Pilfered Proof.
7916-8090-8091.description:
Cast Armed with Proof by paying {2}{W}.
When Armed with Proof enters, it triggers, creating three Clue tokens due to Case of the Pilfered Proof.
When the Clues enter as Equipment due to Armed with Proof, their living weapon abilities given by them to Ekthi each trigger.
Resolve the first living weapon trigger, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and a Clue token due to Case of the Pilfered Proof.
When the Clue enters as an Equipment, its living weapon ability triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and a Clue token due to Case of the Pilfered Proof.
Repeat step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1430-1619-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1619-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirror Image and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1619-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3558-3661-6108-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
3558-3661-6108-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

2511-2946-4871-7316.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2511-2946-4871-7316.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more counters on it

145-687-5411-6099.notablePrerequisites:
There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
You control at least three enchantments.
145-687-5411-6099.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Serra's Sanctum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Serra's Sanctum enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
145-687-5411-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2440-3581-5434-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-5434-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

618-4456-7052-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Savvy Trader.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

141-3967-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3967-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3967-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

4559-4659-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
4559-4659-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-5256-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5256-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5256-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

1409-1770-2307.description:
Activate Corsair Captain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Corsair Captain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Corsair Captain.
Resolve both Corsair Captain triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-5921-5970-6633.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

250-779-1315-1479-6517.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-6517.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

474-2034-4394-4875.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {C}{C}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1018-1309-1987-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1018-1309-1987-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Skullwinder.
When Salvager of Secrets and Skullwinder enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1309-1987-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

710-2730-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4050-5544-6011.notablePrerequisites: Scavenger's Talent is at least level 2.
4050-5544-6011.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Scavenger's Talent's second ability triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Scavenger's Talent trigger, causing an opponent to mill two cards.
Repeat.

487-2773.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
487-2773.description:
Give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible, if needed, then cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage equal to the creature's power to Sporeweb Weaver.
Sporeweb Weaver triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage equal to the Saproling's power to Sporeweb Weaver.
Repeat from step 3.

575-4050-4570.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Timebender, adding {U}.
When Timebender dies, Yedora triggers, returning Timebender from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Timebender by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Timebender's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

262-859-1496.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
262-859-1496.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Verdant Sun's Avatar four times.
Resolve the first Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

484-1934-2232-2661.notablePrerequisites: Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
484-1934-2232-2661.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Tempting Wurm by paying {1}{G}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Tempting Wurm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Tempting Wurm trigger, allowing each opponent to put any number of artifact, enchantment, creature and/or land cards from their hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Sheltering Ancient from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Sheltering Ancient by paying {1}{G}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Sheltering Ancient enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Tempting Wurm from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
